policy: One byte-identical canonical file per SHA-256; all original names remain aliases.

original_metadata.method: Static extraction of embedded MSI and CAB; MSI File/Component/Directory tables used to restore installed filenames and paths. Installer not executed.

findings.note: UBF raw version integers describe board/FPGA payloads and are not interpreted as main firmware versions. Compatibility of FirmwareAFi.UPD with Aptus-II 5 is not established from its filename.
